curation.lead:
Tancredi Salvatore Maria Marchiolo (b. May 1985, Italian) is a London-based hedge-fund partner and the sole director and 75%-plus person of significant control of two UK private companies — Harbour Avenue Limited (CH 12667034, incorporated 12 June 2020) and Harbour V Limited (CH 15531643, incorporated 29 February 2024) — both registered at 101 New Cavendish Street, 1st Floor South, London W1W 6XH, with identical SIC code 96.09 ("other service activities n.e.c.") [Finding #11178][companies-house:12667034][companies-house:15531643]. According to Avvenire reporting, both entities were named in the criminal complaint (esposto) filed at the Procura di Roma on 26 March 2026 by the Italian women's-rights NGO Differenza Donna, which described them as London vehicles "traceable to Italian persons" and asked prosecutors to examine them for money-laundering connected to Epstein-network trafficking allegations [Finding #11178].

Marchiolo's professional trajectory runs through the Mayfair-Geneva hedge-fund alumni rail. According to the Round 6 systemic analysis of records, he worked in the compliance function at Jeffrey Epstein's contemporary Arpad "Arki" Busson's EIM Group (signing emails as TMarchiolo@eim-uk.com as late as 30 June 2012) before becoming a designated member of Bremner Capital LLP (CH OC377122) from 13 March 2013 to 1 March 2016, co-founded with Christopher Piers Julian Bremner — an ex-Atticus Capital figure under Nathaniel "Nat" Rothschild and Tim Barakett [Finding #11199][Finding #11137][Finding #11143][Finding #11169]. Bremner Capital LLP received FCA approval in April 2013 and held SEC IARD #167668; according to the Round 6 meta-synthesis of records, both UK and US regulatory footprints persist as discovery vectors [Finding #11137][Finding #11236].

Marchiolo is identified in the DOJ Epstein document corpus through more than 1,600 emails with Epstein dating from 2010, with peak activity in 2012 (209 documents) and a secondary peak in 2016 (139 documents), per Italian press (L'Espresso, Il Giornale d'Italia) consistent with the House Oversight production [Finding #11137][Finding #11132]. According to the Round 6 audit review of Italian press, Italian outlets reporting on the Differenza Donna esposto have not publicly identified Marchiolo as the controlling person of the two named UK entities, and as of May 2026 he is not under formal investigation, charged, or subject to any judicial measure in Italy [Finding #11199][Finding #11171].
curation.system_role: Marchiolo occupies the structural seam between London hedge-fund services (EIM Group, Bremner Capital LLP) and a pair of late-vintage UK private vehicles whose geography in the Procura di Roma esposto points toward Italian property; the same person who signed Epstein-era correspondence at Bremner now controls the two London companies an Italian prosecutor has been asked to examine.

sections.title: UK Corporate Vehicles
sections.content:
Companies House records show that Marchiolo holds, at both Harbour Avenue Limited and Harbour V Limited, 75%-plus of shares, 75%-plus of voting rights, and the right to appoint or remove directors [Finding #11178][companies-house:12667034][companies-house:15531643]. According to Companies House records, identity verification for Harbour V was performed by Harris & Trotter LLP as Authorised Corporate Service Provider on 15 October 2025 [Finding #11178]. Records show that the two entities share a single registered address (101 New Cavendish Street, 1st Floor South, London W1W 6XH), the same single director-shareholder, and an identical SIC classification (96.09, "other service activities n.e.c.") [Finding #11178].

According to analysis of the Companies House timeline, the four-year gap between Harbour Avenue (incorporated 12 June 2020) and Harbour V (incorporated 29 February 2024) is consistent with a planned vehicle-layering structure rather than two unrelated business ventures [Finding #11178]. According to the Round 6 meta-synthesis of records, the two Harbour companies are characterised as "likely Italian-villa vehicles per esposto geography," reflecting the Capri / Amalfi / Sardinia property focus referenced in Italian press coverage of the Differenza Donna filing — that characterisation is presented as an analyst inference, not an established fact [Finding #11236].

According to the Avvenire report, the Differenza Donna esposto explicitly identifies the two Harbour entities as targets for money-laundering review by the Procura di Roma [Finding #11178]. According to the Round 6 audit review of Italian outlets covering the esposto in February-March 2026 (Open.online, Fanpage, Today.it, Il Giornale d'Italia, La Verità, Panorama, Il Fatto Quotidiano), no source has publicly chained the Harbour entities to Marchiolo as the controlling natural person [Finding #11171].

sections.title: Bremner Capital and EIM Group
sections.content:
According to Companies House records, Bremner Capital LLP was a London hedge fund co-founded by Marchiolo and Christopher Bremner; the firm received UK Financial Conduct Authority approval in April 2013 and operated from 15 Stratton Street, Mayfair [Finding #11199][Finding #11137][Finding #11143]. Bremner Capital's stated strategy was "innovative back-to-basics thematic global L/S product... aim at 25% returns with average volatility of 12-14%" — a concentrated thematic long/short equity book with a biotech bias, per a 29 January 2013 strategy note [Finding #11143]. According to Companies House records, Marchiolo served as a designated member from 13 March 2013 to 1 March 2016; the firm wound down in an orderly fashion (no insolvency, no liquidator), with compulsory dissolution recorded on 20 June 2017 [Finding #11143][Finding #11137].

According to Companies House records, Christopher Bremner is the controlling principal — a 75-100% person of significant control of Bremner Capital LLP and its parent Bremner Capital UK Ltd (CH 08150769) — and is described as a former "key figure" at Atticus Capital, the Tim Barakett fund where Rothschild-family member Nathaniel Rothschild served as co-chairman 1996-2009 [Finding #11143]. Examination of the corpus shows the earliest documented Epstein-Bremner contact recorded is a 17 April 2012 New York meeting; according to the records, the next day Lesley Groff asked Glenn Dubin to call Nat Rothschild for a backchannel reference on Bremner [Finding #11143]. Analysis of that diligence call indicates it only makes sense if Bremner had substantive Atticus tenure, which independently corroborates the "key figure at Atticus" framing [Finding #11143].

According to records, before joining Bremner, Marchiolo worked in compliance at EIM Group / EIM-UK, the Geneva-London hedge-fund-of-funds founded by Arpad Busson; he was still signing TMarchiolo@eim-uk.com on 30 June 2012 [Finding #11199][Finding #11137]. According to analysis of the records in Finding #11169, the Mayfair-Geneva alumni rail (EIM, Bremner, Atticus) is one of two independent Rothschild-orbit corporate-administration anchors into the wider 15-actor system identified in the Round 5/6 systemic analysis; that systemic claim is presented as an analyst synthesis [Finding #11169].

sections.title: Epstein Correspondence Footprint
sections.content:
According to Italian outlets L'Espresso and Il Giornale d'Italia, the corpus of more than 1,600 emails between Marchiolo and Epstein begins in 2010 — a count consistent with the House Oversight Committee production [Finding #11137][Finding #11132]. According to records of the locally-indexed lmsband_epstein_files.db corpus, 503 OCR'd files match the surname "Marchiolo," with date distribution: 2010 (14), 2011 (198), 2012 (209), 2013 (125), 2014 (45), 2015 (36), 2016 (139), 2017 (26), 2018 (39) [Finding #11137]. Analysis of those date clusters indicates the 2012 peak overlaps Marchiolo's transition from EIM compliance to Bremner Capital co-founding partner, and the secondary 2016 peak overlaps his March 2016 designated-member resignation [Finding #11137][Finding #11143].

According to the records, the corpus contains 6 documented in-person meetings at Epstein residences between August 2010 and October 2013 — including an April 2012 New York visit at 301 East 66th Street with Christopher Bremner and television presenter Donna Air; an October 2012 Paris visit including Glenn Dubin-network figures; a February 2011 St. Moritz meeting; a Harbour Island visit in August 2010; a Rome solo meeting in August 2011; and an October 2013 Paris meeting [Finding #11137]. According to the records, Finding #11137 documents specific email evidence including a 9 April 2013 message that interleaved a Bremner Capital fundraising update ("authorised by FSA 2 days ago... +43% portfolio since November... initial commitments 40") with non-business content; Finding #11142 separately documents Marchiolo's role placing Bremner Capital LLP investor-relations employee Vaiva Marija Martinonytė into a 27 February-3 March 2013 New York vetting trip from which she was rejected [Finding #11137][Finding #11142].

According to the records, the open-source footprint is sparse — no LinkedIn, no Twitter, no Bloomberg quotes — and Finding #11137 describes that pattern as deliberate distancing; Christopher Bremner sends no direct emails to Epstein in the corpus, while Marchiolo signs all Bremner-side correspondence [Finding #11137][Finding #11143].

sections.title: Procura di Roma Esposto (26 March 2026)
sections.content:
According to Avvenire, the Italian women's-rights NGO Differenza Donna filed an esposto at the Procura di Roma on 26 March 2026 alleging "transnational trafficking, sexual violence, sexual exploitation, money laundering" and naming Harbour Avenue Limited and Harbour V Limited (101 New Cavendish Street, London) as London entities "traceable to Italian persons" [Finding #11178]. According to the Avvenire report, the two Harbour companies are explicitly identified as targets for money-laundering review [Finding #11178].

According to records, the esposto itself does not name Marchiolo as an indagato (formal suspect); according to the Round 6 audit review of Italian press as of May 2026, no outlet had publicly chained the two UK companies to Marchiolo as the controlling natural person, although the prosecutor's filing identifies the entities by Companies House registration [Finding #11199][Finding #11171]. According to the analysis in Finding #11171, the Procura di Roma esposto is the first prosecutorial frame to draw together the Mayfair-Geneva hedge-fund cluster (Harbour Avenue, Harbour V) and what the analyst summary calls the Roman 1965 birth cohort (Eduardo Teodorani-Fabbri and others) into a single criminal-investigation frame; that systemic claim is presented as an analyst synthesis [Finding #11171].

According to records, the esposto is procedurally an "exposé" — a citizen complaint that triggers prosecutor review. According to analysis in Finding #11205, the case has an estimated 6-12 week window for formal fascicolo assignment, situating the case alongside other European Epstein-files prosecutorial actions in France, Poland, Norway, and the United Kingdom; according to that analysis, Norway's Okokrim treatment of the DOJ release as "notitia criminis sufficiente" is the procedural template invoked in the Italian filing [Finding #11205].

sections.title: Naming and Verification Notes
sections.content:
According to the Round 6 meta-synthesis review of records, several name corrections are relevant to this dossier: the previously-circulating "Antoine Bremner" reference is unverified and likely a corruption of Christopher Bremner — examination of the Companies House officer record (officer ID RW1Gq8ianKCI7a9R0Nx6Vx8AFTI) shows only one UK appointment for Christopher Piers Julian Bremner (DOB June 1964, dual British/Australian) at Bremner Capital LLP and its parent [Finding #11236][Finding #11143]. According to records, the earlier "Vaiva Kazlauskaite" framing has likewise been corrected to Vaiva Marija Martinonytė per Companies House officer ID and EFTA00394227 [Finding #11142].

According to the Round 6 audit review of Italian press, Marchiolo is not named as an indagato in any Italian press reporting reviewed through May 2026; the Differenza Donna esposto names the two UK companies, not their controlling natural person [Finding #11171][Finding #11199]. According to the Round 6 meta-synthesis, the "Italian-villa vehicles" characterisation of the two Harbour entities is presented as an analyst inference based on the geography described in the esposto and is not stated as established fact [Finding #11236].

open_questions: What asset bases sit inside Harbour Avenue Limited and Harbour V Limited? Companies House micro-entity accounts since 2020 and 2024 should be cross-referenced against any Italian Land Registry (Catasto / Conservatoria) holdings whose ultimate beneficial owner traces to Marchiolo.

Who provided initial capital to Bremner Capital LLP? The 9 April 2013 email referenced in Finding #11137 cites 'initial commitments 40' (interpretable as $40M) at FCA approval; the LP roster has not been resolved against the Cayman Master/Onshore/Offshore feeder structure.

Did Marchiolo's EIM Group / EIM-UK compliance role overlap with any specific Epstein-introduced investor or fund — and if so, was the Bremner Capital launch underwritten by capital first cultivated at EIM?

What is the relationship between Harris & Trotter LLP (the ACSP that verified Marchiolo's identity for Harbour V on 15 October 2025) and other ACSP/registered-office providers used by London-Italian fund vehicles in the Mayfair cluster?
Will the Procura di Roma esposto produce a fascicolo and named indagati, and will Italian press connect Marchiolo to the two UK companies before any formal charging decision?
